properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.site-address: Slate Hall Farm, North Lane, North Sunderland
properties.notes: Land that was previously occupied by a farmsteading but, as a result of development, is now situated in an established residential area within the settlement. The former agricultural buildings have been cleared at an earlier date. Redevelopment of the site has been proposed for a number of years. A range of applications have been permitted for this, none of which have been not delivered (07/B/0579, 07/B/0594, 11/00226/FUL). There is an extant planning permission in place for a development of 6 homes on the cleared site (15/02434/FUL). Despite there being no substantive progress to date on the residential aspect of the development, the permission has been implemented through initial site works, so it will not lapse. Completion is forecast within the next 5 years.
